title: NVIDIA Announces 2028 Rubin HPC GPU with Over 50,000 CUDA Cores
digest:
NVIDIA announced on November 17, 2026, that its Rubin HPC GPU will launch in 2028 with over 50,000 CUDA cores and new interconnect technology for scientific computing, though no benchmark data was disclosed.

The GPU aims to enhance computational efficiency in fields like climate modeling and molecular dynamics, leveraging its high core count and optimized interconnects for parallel processing tasks.

NVIDIA did not release performance benchmarks or simulation results, leaving market analysts to question whether the technical specifications alone justify claims of 'significant advancements' in scientific computing.
